title: Adjuvant Capecitabine Monotherapy in Stage III Colon Adenocarcinoma

drugs.schedule: twice daily, days 1-14, repeated every 3 weeks for 8 cycles

inclusion_criteria: Histologically confirmed stage III colon adenocarcinoma
Adequate bone marrow, hepatic, and renal function
Completed surgical resection within 8 weeks of enrolment
exclusion_criteria: Prior chemotherapy or radiotherapy for colon cancer
